journey.name: contacts entry points
journey.description: Precondition: an onboarded disposable wallet with Paykit enabled, no Pubky identity, unseen Contacts and Profile intros, and an English device. A second run uses an authenticated disposable profile with the Contacts intro already seen. Delayed identity lookup and failed session restoration need fault injection outside journey capabilities and are covered by the ProfileDestinationViewTests regressions and the PR manual checks.

actions.action: Open the Home menu (identifier "HeaderMenu") and tap Contacts (identifier "DrawerContacts")
Verify Contacts intro (identifier "ContactsIntro") appears after loading finishes
Return Home and open Contacts from the menu again
Verify Profile intro (identifier "ProfileIntro") appears without Contacts intro
On the authenticated profile run, open Contacts from the Home menu
Verify the Contacts list and Add button (identifier "ContactsAddButton") appear without Profile onboarding
